scope: Source field and discovery contract review only; no source records, schemas, runtime code or Aura were changed.

authorities.role: Current writer and actual field authority; allows arbitrary additional payload fields.
Context only: stale required-field list omits summary, stale type enum omits ticket_completion and feature, and configuration wording predates writer self-location.
Native type inventory; the observed source is Markdown with YAML frontmatter, not the YAML documents claimed by older component prose.

discovery.configuration: Use the current changelogs_dir declaration when present, supporting the development template location and the deployed leafcutter/template location used by the writer. Default to changelogs. Keep docs/changelog as explicit legacy source. Resolve paths within the supplied immutable root and deduplicate overlapping resolved paths.
discovery.configuration_authority: scripts/changelog/emit_entry.py actually reads leafcutter/templates/scripts/commit_guardian/commit_guardian.json and falls back to changelogs. In this development checkout the declaration is templates/scripts/commit_guardian/commit_guardian.json. Do not use the README's obsolete changelog_folder claim as the sole authority.
exclusions: README.md and index.md folder guidance or indexes
root CHANGELOG.md legacy monolithic history is not one per-entry record
scripts/changelog/README.md describes the writer and is a Document, not an entry
templates and generated copies of source entries
discovery.routing: Document traversal must exclude both canonical and legacy changelog source directories so each entry has one native identity.
discovery.missing_store: An absent current or legacy folder contributes no records; neither folder should be manufactured.
discovery.filename_variations: Do not enforce the new YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-slug.md filename regex on historical records; 2026-05-28-current-epic-frontendagent-complete.md is a real entry. Folder and Markdown record content are the source contract.

identity.native_id: Repository-relative source path including directory and extension.
identity.source_path: The same repository-relative path using forward slashes.
identity.locator: Empty string for one entry per file.
identity.reason: The writer defines no id field. Filename collision suffixes are meaningful, titles and dates are not unique, and separate current/legacy directories must not collide. Do not derive identity from title or truncate to date.
identity.title: Use exact nonempty string frontmatter title for display; fallback to the filename stem is derived presentation only and must not manufacture metadata.title.
identity.description: Use authored description as display summary when it is a string; otherwise authored summary if it is a string, while preserving both separately in metadata. Missing description stays absent.
identity.revision: Read and hash the file at the immutable source revision being projected, including retained generation backfills.

current_writer_validation.required_means: validate_payload checks key presence, not non-nullness or complete scalar types/formats.
conditional_requirements: epic key when type is epic_completion
ticket key when type is ticket_completion
truthy breaking requires nonempty list migration_steps
current_writer_validation.historical_ingestion_rule: Do not call the current writer validator as an ingestion gate. It is a new-write rule, not a historical schema. Preserve old enum values and missing fields without substituting defaults.

field_inventory.name: title
field_inventory.meaning: Entry heading, not stable identity. Exact authored value remains available through /title when graph presentation reserves title.

field_inventory.name: date
field_inventory.meaning: Authored entry date, normally YYYY-MM-DD. Preserve quoted string versus YAML date scalar; never replace with ingestion date.

field_inventory.name: time
field_inventory.meaning: Authored clock time, normally HH:MM. Some unquoted YAML 1.1 sexagesimal scalars parse as integers. Preserve parsed type and full raw frontmatter; do not guess a timezone, pad, or coerce integers into strings.

field_inventory.name: type
field_inventory.meaning: Changelog event subtype, separate from graph kind ChangelogEntry. Observed historic ac_authoring and fix are preserved.

field_inventory.name: components
field_inventory.meaning: Declared affected component identifiers. Preserve order and duplicates in source /components; derive graph membership only for exact resolvable entries, never infer registry aliases or fabricate components.

field_inventory.name: summary
field_inventory.meaning: Business-language one-liner; distinct from technical description and Markdown body. Expose /summary when graph bookkeeping reserves summary.

field_inventory.name: description
field_inventory.meaning: Detailed change description. Two valid historical records omit it; preserve absence. Two additional malformed records have unambiguously recoverable writer-escaped descriptions.

field_inventory.name: epic
field_inventory.meaning: Epic basename or human title; preserve exact declaration without pretending it is always a resolvable path.

field_inventory.name: ticket
field_inventory.meaning: Single ticket basename or title; separate from plural tickets. Writer serializes it through the remaining-keys loop.

field_inventory.name: pr
field_inventory.meaning: Pull request reference; integer numbers, strings and explicit null are not interchangeable. Never infer a repository URL or coerce null into an empty string.

field_inventory.name: adrs
field_inventory.meaning: Declared ADR references, which may be short IDs, stems or paths. Preserve original values/order without inventing resolved identities.

field_inventory.name: diagrams
field_inventory.meaning: Declared diagram/document traceability paths; distinct from adrs.

field_inventory.name: tickets
field_inventory.meaning: Plural related ticket references; preserve values independently of the required ticket field for ticket_completion.

field_inventory.name: commits
field_inventory.meaning: Declared commit references. Unquoted numeric-only abbreviated SHAs were parsed as integers by YAML. Preserve exact parsed types, raw source, explicit null and empty list; do not invent missing SHA characters.

field_inventory.name: breaking
field_inventory.meaning: Authored compatibility declaration used by SemVer consumers. Missing is distinct from false; do not add the writer's runtime false default to historical metadata.

field_inventory.name: migration_steps
field_inventory.required_by_current_writer: nonempty list when breaking is truthy
field_inventory.meaning: Ordered migration instructions. A valid existing record has a mapping item caused by an unquoted colon; preserve the actual parsed map and item correlation. Only the one YAML-failing literal-list writer defect qualifies for narrow recovery.

field_inventory.name: scope
field_inventory.meaning: Open-mapping extension; do not merge with components.

field_inventory.name: merge_commit
field_inventory.meaning: Explicit merge commit extension; preserve separately from commits.

field_inventory.name: acs
field_inventory.meaning: Declared acceptance-criterion references; not globally required and not inferred from the body.

field_inventory.name: created
field_inventory.meaning: Legacy document frontmatter created date; separate from changelog date.

field_inventory.name: last_updated
field_inventory.meaning: Legacy document lifecycle date, not graph refresh timestamp.

field_inventory.name: status
field_inventory.meaning: Legacy document status, observed active. Distinct from changelog type and graph current.

field_inventory.name: other supplied fields
field_inventory.meaning: The writer emits arbitrary remaining keys. Preserve extension scalars, lists and nested structures without a lossy allowlist or invented universal requirement.

nested_and_body_contract.ordinary_properties: Expose simple scalars and homogeneous primitive arrays directly where names do not collide with graph bookkeeping.
nested_and_body_contract.nested_properties: Use shared indexed JSON-pointer leaves for heterogeneous arrays and maps, including migration_steps/0/<escaped-label>. Preserve object keys, list positions and map/list identity with the common shape manifest.

value.Before staging a ticket as status: done, ensure files_touched lists every source file (.py/.sql/.ts/.tsx/.js) actually modified on the branch.

nested_and_body_contract.null_and_empty: Explicit null, empty list and absent key remain distinguishable; no missing-field default injection.
nested_and_body_contract.body: Preserve exact Markdown after the whole-line closing --- delimiter separately in derived.body. The writer initializes only a bare ## Entry heading; later authored sections and tables are content, not a new field schema. Do not parse prose headings into invented universal fields.
nested_and_body_contract.raw_frontmatter: Preserve exact source text between the opening and closing delimiter in derived.frontmatter_raw, including quoting and scalar spelling. The parsed metadata stays separate and queryable.
nested_and_body_contract.record_contract: Return common.NativeRecord from extract(root), with metadata as the full source mapping and derived provenance/body kept separate. No Aura access or graph mutation in the reader.

malformed_records.error: mapping values are not allowed here; the second literal list item contains both output_root: .leafcutter and shim_strategy: symlink without YAML quoting

compatibility_recovery_contract: Try the strict common frontmatter parser first. Compatibility recovery is for an actual failing field only; never re-interpret any valid YAML scalar, mapping or list.

The writer _yaml_value quotes strings with double quotes and replaces embedded double quotes with backslash-double-quote, but does not escape existing backslashes. A whole-line double-quoted description failing specifically on an invalid YAML backslash escape can therefore decode the writer's own escaping rule while preserving all literal backslashes.

The writer serializes each list element as a literal indented dash line. A failing migration_steps field consisting entirely of simple, equally indented, one-line list items can preserve each literal item string in order. This fixes only the failing field, not a valid map item in another entry.

Use safely parsed sibling fields unchanged. Preserve full raw frontmatter, exact recovered field fragments, original parse error and the named recovery rule separately under derived parsing provenance.

Do not modify source files, strip punctuation, replace backslashes globally, guess multiline scalar semantics, coerce all migration items, or silently drop a record. Unsupported or ambiguous malformed shapes must fail explicitly with the path and field.
Record recovered metadata as compatibility-parsed with auditable provenance, not as strict YAML parse success. Parent integration approved these two narrow writer-specific recoveries on 2026-10-02.

verification_requirements_for_coder: One fixture exercising every declared writer field, extension keys, exact body and raw frontmatter, mixed commit scalar types, explicit null and empty lists, YAML dates, and no invented missing values.

Legacy fixture retains historic type fix/ac_authoring and missing description without applying current writer rejection/default rules; same filename in two source directories yields distinct native IDs.
Configured current directory and legacy directory discovery, safe root containment, absent stores, guidance exclusions, and overlap deduplication.

Both writer-defect recoveries retain all safely parsed siblings and complete exact recovered values, with raw fragment, original error and named rule. A valid migration mapping item remains a mapping.
Malformed or ambiguous unsupported frontmatter still raises; negative tests must prove that reader does not silently skip or invent values.
Real checkout extraction should account for 531 entries, 528 strict parses and 3 auditable compatibility parses; report exact counts rather than claiming every source passes today's writer rules.
